name: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery
summary: Southeast of Darkshire, Tranquil Gardens Cemetery is overrun by shambling skeletons and ghouls. The former burial site has become an immediate hazard for the nearby town.

sections.title: Restless Grounds
sections.body: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery was once a quiet resting place for the departed of Grand Hamlet. Dark curses settled over Duskwood, and the dead buried here began clawing their way out of their plots. Skeletal warriors, skeletal mages, and wandering undead haunt the gravestones. Though relatively weak beside the horrors deeper in the woods, they pose a relentless threat to townsfolk so close to Darkshire.

sections.title: On the Town's Threshold
sections.body: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies close to Darkshire's edge, making it the Night Watch's frontline. The Watch often sends fresh recruits and arriving adventurers to cull the rising dead before they reach the settlement. More dangerous threats, such as the Insane Ghoul, lurk among the tumbled headstones and the ruined chapel.

faq.q: Why is it called Tranquil Gardens if it is full of undead?
faq.answer: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery was established when Darkshire was still known as Grand Hamlet, a peaceful settlement in a then-sunlit forest. It was meant to be a quiet, dignified resting place for local families. The name became grimly ironic after the curse fell over the region and the dead began rising from their graves.

faq.q: What threats wander around the cemetery?
faq.answer: The grounds are infested with relatively weak undead, including shambling skeletons, skeletal warriors, and skeletal mages. A particularly vicious Insane Ghoul haunts the ruined chapel or roams the headstones.

faq.q: Why does the Night Watch send recruits here?
faq.answer: The cemetery sits immediately southeast of Darkshire, so unchecked undead numbers threaten to spill directly into town. The Night Watch uses the site to blood new defenders against weaker undead before sending them deeper into the dangerous forest.

faq.q: Who lives just north of the cemetery?
faq.answer: Just north of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, an isolated cottage is home to Blind Mary, a spirit who lingers near the blighted graveyard.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face an affront to the Holy Light in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. The graveyard is an urgent proving ground for those seeking to grant peace to Duskwood's restless dead.
As an Alliance champion arriving in Darkshire, you help defend this nearby graveyard and keep the town's perimeter secure from an undead breach.
